versions.content: The LIN Interface shall call the function <User_TriggerTransmit> with the PduInfoPtr pointer containing data buffer (SduDataPtr) and buffer length (SduLength) to get the data part of the frame (data in the LIN frame response) when a schedule entry for a frame transmission is due.
